OK, there's a big new player owned house update - give me the lowdown? Last time I did construction was 2008

Welcome back to the world of home building! If the last time you touched Construction was in 2008, you're probably remembering the painful, hand-cramping days of building and instantly demolishing Oak Larders or Mahogany Tables while constantly bribing your Demon Butler. 

Construction in RS3 has evolved dramatically. While traditional Player-Owned Houses (POH) still exist for utility and cosmetic storage, the way we train and interact with the skill has completely shifted with major modern updates like **Fort Forinthry** and **Construction Contracts**.

Here is the lowdown on everything that has changed, along with how to leverage these updates at your current **Level 74 Construction** toward your **Construction Max** goal.

---

### 1. Fort Forinthry: The Modern "Player-Owned Base"
The biggest update to Construction in RS3 is **[Fort Forinthry](https://runescape.wiki/w/Fort_Forinthry)** (introduced via the *New Foundations* quest). Instead of building isolated rooms in a portal dimension, you build a massive, fully functional fortress in Wilderness/Misthalin border lands.

* **AFK & Linear Building:** You no longer spam "Build/Remove". You create refined planks (Frame construction) at the Fort workshop and build structures lineally on designated spots. It is significantly more AFK and relaxed!
* **Valuable Skill Buffs:** Fort buildings provide huge account-wide perks:
  * **Workshop:** Grants bonus XP/saving materials across Smithing, Crafting, and Fletching.
  * **Chapel:** Gives higher Prayer XP than a standard POH altar and automatically applies altar buffs.
  * **Command Centre:** Increases rewards from Miscellania and Port missions.
  * **Town Hall:** Generates rest bonus XP while logged off.
* **Tiered Progress:** At **Level 74 Construction**, you can build up to **Tier 2/Tier 3** Fort structures, earning massive lump sums of XP along the way.

---

### 2. POH Aquarium (Crucial for your 99 Fishing goal!)
While traditional POHs are less commonly used for active training today, the **[Aquarium](https://runescape.wiki/w/Aquarium)** room (unlocked at **Level 63 Construction**) is a **must-build** room for your account right now, especially since **99 Fishing** is on your active To-Do list!

* **Perk Plugs:** By upgrading your Aquarium and collecting fish eggs, you unlock permanent account perks:
  * **Baitless Fishing:** Fish without needing feathers, bait, or lures in your inventory.
  * **Free Clue Scrolls:** The Aquarium gives you a weekly chance at free clue scrolls.
  * **Free Great White Sharks:** Adds raw sharks to your bank periodically.
  * **Decennial Catch:** Boosts your chance at catching elite fish.

---

### 3. Construction Contracts (Alternative Active Method)
If you want a mobile, cost-effective training method akin to Mahogany Homes, **[Construction Contracts](https://runescape.wiki/w/Construction_Contracts)** allow you to take jobs from Estate Agents to travel around Gielinor fixing citizens' furniture.

* **Low Cost, High XP:** Requires far fewer planks than flatpacks or traditional POH building.
* **Contract Credits:** Earn credits to buy the **[Master Construction Outfit](https://runescape.wiki/w/Master_construction_outfit)** (saves planks, gives bonus XP, teleport abilities) and the **Planker's Blueprint**.

---

### 4. Modern Quality-of-Life & Invention Synergy

| Feature | 2008 Construction | Modern RS3 Construction |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Training Flow** | Click -> Build Larder -> Remove -> Butler -> Repeat | AFK Fort Forinthry / [Portable Workbenches](https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_workbench) |
| **Cost Reduction** | Full plank cost, no refund | Portable workbenches & [Master Outfit](https://runescape.wiki/w/Master_construction_outfit) save 10–15%+ planks |
| **Invention Integration** | None | **Plank Maker** machine in Invention automatically makes planks passively |
| **POH Storage** | Standard Costume Room | Integrated with Bank system (withdraw armor directly from Bank) |

---

### 🎯 Strategic Action Plan for RozRaid (Level 74 Construction)

1. **Start Fort Forinthry (*New Foundations* Quest):**
   * Begin building Fort Forinthry. The XP rates from building the initial walls and upgrading to Tier 2/Tier 3 structures are huge and extremely fast.
2. **Build the POH Aquarium Room:**
   * Build an **Aquarium** room in your house immediately. Load it up with fish eggs to unlock baitless fishing before pushing your **Level 94 Fishing to 99**.
3. **Use Portable Workbenches for Fast Levels:**
   * If speed-leveling flatpacks/frames, join world 84 or use **[Portable Workbenches](https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_workbench)** at a bank bankstand. You get extra XP and save substantial plank costs.
4. **Leverage Invention (Level 48+ Invention):**
   * Look into crafting Invention tools like the **Plank Maker** machine at the Invention Guild once you level up Invention further, passive plank creation will fund your path to 99/120 Construction!
